intent: Ensure the vehicle has right-of-way and reduces the risk of colliding with other vehicles or pedestrians.
Prioritizing safety due to the immediate hazard posed by a pedestrian entering the crosswalk.
To ensure immediate safety and prevent potential collision with the pedestrian who is directly in the roadway.
To prioritize safety by ensuring the immediate hazard (pedestrian in path) is resolved before proceeding.
Reducing speed ensures a safe distance from the crossing pedestrian and allows for continued motion once it is confirmed that the pedestrian has finished crossing safely.
